title: Successor beneficiary with unknown original facts
catches: A fresh 10-year window granted to a successor beneficiary.

expected.requiredMessage: Inherited retirement distribution schedule cannot be determined from available data.

notes: A successor generally steps into the REMAINDER of the original window, not a new one. With the original facts unknown, no date can be computed. The module must refuse rather than default to 2036-12-31.
